candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the downstream order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show each checkout 502 paired with an order 500, so the failure originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within the order service (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the 500 origin is bounded.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are fast (15-63ms) and every failing checkout correlates with an order-service 500 on POST /v1/orders in traces and logs. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). The bounded cause is order-service HTTP 500 propagating to the gateway; the specific internal fault is not yet evidenced.
